decisions.target_truth: Keep batch=a group/quantity handled or produced together and verb batch=process in groups. Current center and in batches usage are sufficient.
Keep bath=act of bathing, bathtub, and low specialist immersion-liquid use. Current hierarchy is acceptable.

Center bathe on washing/immersing a person or body part and the figurative be bathed in light/liquid. Mark bathe=swim and noun have a bathe as British and/or dated/low-priority rather than ordinary co-equal Active meanings.

Keep bathroom=room with bathing/toilet facilities and go to the bathroom usage. The Current bathroom↔toilet regional contrast is acceptable because it explicitly notes regional variation and toilet's fixture sense.
Keep battery=electric cell/device and a battery of tests/questions=organized set as learner-worthy. Military battery and legal battery may remain lower recognition senses.
Keep military battle, figurative determined struggle/effort, and verb battle against/for/with. Current newly restored nonmilitary struggle branch is learner-worthy and well separated.

Center bay on the coastal inlet. Preserve bay/bay at for a hound's prolonged cry only as lower recognition, and add the high-value construction keep/hold sth at bay=prevent something threatening from approaching or worsening. Do not let archaic corner/bring-to-bay senses dominate.

Knowledge truth must include be as linking/existence/location verb AND its fundamental auxiliary roles in progressive and passive constructions. Current owner omits the auxiliary grammatical function, which is too central to leave outside lexical truth.
Keep beach=sandy/pebbly shore beside sea/lake and low verb beach a boat=run/haul it ashore.
Keep beam=structural member, beam of light, beam=smile broadly, and lower transmit/beam a signal. Current branches are useful and distinct.

Broaden bean beyond 'edible seed in a long pod' to the ordinary lexical family of bean/bean-like seeds, so coffee/cocoa beans do not contradict the definition. Keep edible legumes central but do not define the word so narrowly that its own common examples fall outside it.

Keep bear=animal plus high-value verbs carry/support, endure/tolerate, produce/give birth or yield, and relevant constructions. Remove duplicate learner objects where the carry/support meaning is already Active and repeated in secondary_senses; do not multiply equivalent branches.
Keep beard=hair on lower face/chin as the main ordinary noun. Historical/rare verb uses may remain reference-only.

Put have a bearing on sth=have relevance/effect/influence into the Core because it is a major reading sense. Keep demeanor/carriage and mechanical bearing as distinct lower branches; endure/childbearing-derived uses should not crowd the main learner map.
Keep beast=animal/wild animal, brutal person, and lower abstract beastliness/animal nature. Current hierarchy is acceptable.

Keep repeated hitting, defeat/surpass, heartbeat/rhythm and related common branches, but expand defeat/surpass beyond a person/opponent to beat a record/time/price and add common beat eggs/cream=mix vigorously. Do not force these ordinary uses under an overly narrow competition sense.
Use one broad beautiful=very attractive/pleasing/excellent center. Beautiful weather is an ordinary application, not a separate co-equal sense; avoid dictionary-style splitting by object domain.

Keep beauty=quality of being beautiful and a beauty=a beautiful/excellent person or thing, but represent the latter once. Current owner duplicates a beauty as both a collocation under the first sense and a separate second sense.
Keep because=for the reason that and high-value because of + noun phrase as its structural counterpart.
Keep become=begin to be/come to be as the dominant linking verb and formal lower become sb=suit/be fitting to someone. Current hierarchy is acceptable.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
